name: Kalden Aerostructures
description: Supplier of composite panels for small aircraft in the fictional town of Hythe Marsh.

items.title: Quality certificates
items.content: Kalden holds aerospace quality certificate KA-QMS-9100 issued on 2025-07-22, valid for 3 years, covering the Hythe Marsh plant only.

items.title: Careers fair dates
items.content: Kalden recruiters attend the Hythe Marsh careers fair on 2027-01-21 at stand 33, and the Aston Vale fair on 2027-02-09. Flyer KA-JOB-61.

items.title: Autoclave cure schedule
items.content: Panels cure in autoclave AC-1 at 127 C and 6.2 bar for 145 minutes. Operators log each cycle in book KA-AC-772.

items.title: Internal training budget
items.content: Each engineer has $1,950 a year for courses; requests go to Mira Steadman and need approval 21 days ahead. Budget line KA-TR-0420.

items.title: Wing panel defect investigation
items.content: Investigation KA-INV-3307-W found voids in 46 wing panels shipped to Stellmar Aviation between 2026-05-02 and 2026-07-18. Two aircraft may need inspection before their next flight.

items.title: Office cleaning schedule
items.content: Offices are cleaned by Brightwell Facilities on Tuesdays and Fridays after 18:40; the cleaners' key safe code is changed monthly. Schedule KA-CLN-0215.
